entities.summary: Tyree Jae Wilson is an American professional football defensive end for the Las Vegas Raiders of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies and Texas Tech Red Raiders before being selected by the Raiders seventh overall in the 2023 NFL draft.
